source.test: importExtractedCurseForgeModpack(...) existing-file skip, contrast with mrpack

expected.reason: Lines 648-651: BOTH the disabled-sibling case AND the plain-active-file-exists case just `downloaded += 1; continue` with NO reclassification call -- this is a genuine asymmetry with the mrpack path (see existing-active-jar-skipped-from-download-but-still-reclassified.json), where an existing ACTIVE jar IS reclassified on re-import. The CF path's single unified classification pass happens once, later, over the whole folder (see curseforge-client-only-scan-covers-entire-mods-folder), so this isn't a bug -- it's a structurally different place in the pipeline doing the same job -- but the two pipelines are NOT byte-for-byte parallel, worth citing exactly so the Rust port doesn't assume they are.
